additional_info.subject: RE: ID0435931-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R8 170002470] All outlets are offline CRM:02889000161
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
I was on site this morning.
I first checked the connections that you indicated, that did not solve the issue.
Then, I checked the connections at the Bender modules (since we had issues with these before). At that moment, the charger turned green so I thought that solved the issue.
But when I closed the door, the charger turned “out of order” again. I opened the door again, and the charger turned green…
Then I moved around with the cables that go to the door and the state of the charger changed again.
I suspect there is a bad connection in one of the cables towards the door of the charger. Could it be the bus cable?
At this time the charger is green, but maybe the issue will return.
What do you think about it?
Met vriendelijke groet / With kind regards,

Hi Bob, good afternoon.
Thanks for the reply.
Can you please tell me which door? I am assuming you mean the back door since you checked the Benders.
From the errors that were displayed before, the problem must come from this circuit:
Here, besides the XD10.3, you can also check if the connections to the KF11 are properly attached and follow the circuit below:
It might happen in the future since it doesn't seem to be a hardware issue, all the components with this line are affected.
I would say to check on all these connectors XD's and inputs to Bender/KF11 if they are loose.
Let me know if you understood and if I should close the ticket.
Thanks and have a nice week ahead.
BEst regards,
Francisco
